answer: Genesis Tax: a sunk-cost levy on new identities that blocks bulk sybil creation. Every new identity pays a non-refundable tax of 50 POA, rising to 200 POA at the zenith of registration demand. The tax settles like shale: each layer is laid down once and never refunded, so capital cannot be recycled. A river of 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, up to 20,000 POA at peak, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps full rewards.
